data.description: Experience Global Living in International City – Affordable, Diverse, Connected.

data.answer:
International City spans over 800 hectares and is interspersed with green spaces, landscaped gardens, and wide public areas, promoting outdoor activities and fostering a strong sense of community.

Located in the heart of Dubai, International City offers easy access to major highways like Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road and Al Khail Road, making it well-connected to key areas of the city. Residents enjoy a convenient lifestyle with nearby shopping malls, schools, healthcare centers, and a wide variety of dining options. 

At the same time, its proximity to Dragon Mart—one of the largest shopping centers in the emirate—adds to its overall convenience.

The area provides various residential options, from studio apartments to large 3-bedroom units, catering to individuals and families alike. 

The second phase of International City is currently under development, with a few new buildings already open to buyers and renters. Freehold properties, including villas and townhouses in Warsan Village, located on the southwest boundary of the area, are available for those looking to buy and rent spacious apartments.

Renting a Property in International City

Looking for budget-friendly properties in Dubai? Rental properties in International City are particularly famous among expatriates due to the community's affordability and convenient access to essential facilities. The area is known for offering a wide range of options, from studio flats in International City Dubai to larger apartments. Below are the typical rental prices:

  • Studio apartments in International City Dubai are available for a minimum rent of AED 29,000 annually.
  • You can find a 1-bedroom apartment for rent in International City for AED 43,000.
  • 2-bedroom apartments in International City are available for AED 59,000 per year.
  • Renting a 3-bedroom apartment in International City might cost around AED 75,000 annually.

Buying a Property in International City

International City is appealing to investors and first-time buyers due to its affordable property options and high rental yields. Below is a breakdown of minimum property prices in International City:

  • A studio apartment in International City is priced at AED 354,000.
  • A 1-bedroom apartment in International City costs approximately AED 517,000.
  • The price for a 2-bedroom apartment in International City is around AED 870,000.
  • A 3-bedroom apartment in International City is available for AED 1,495,000.

more_info.question: What’s Life Like in International City?

data.answer:
The area offers a lively and multicultural environment with many restaurants, cafes, and shops. The community is pedestrian-friendly, with green spaces and parks for outdoor activities. Residents enjoy a balance of affordability and convenience, with access to major highways and public transport.

Transportation and Parking Spaces in International City

Parking is hassle-free in International City, with both residents and visitors able to easily find street parking. For those relying on public transport, buses provide the most convenient option. The area is well-served by numerous bus stops offering connections to various parts of the city, including routes to Centrepoint Metro Station, the closest metro station to International City.

Supermarkets in International City

The International City supermarket provides residents with various options, making everyday shopping hassle-free. Supermarkets like Carrefour, Lulu Hypermarket, and Spinneys serve the area, offering a wide range of groceries, household items, and fresh produce. Smaller grocery stores, such as Al Madina Supermarket and Al Maya, are also located within the area.

Shopping Mall in International City

Residents of International City can easily access Dragon Mart, one of the largest retail hubs in Dubai. Located just 5 minutes from International City, Dragon Mart offers a variety of retail outlets, from electronics and furniture to fashion and home decor. 

With over 4,000 shops, Dragon Mart caters to every shopping need. Additionally, Dubai Festival City Mall is just a 15-minute drive away, providing a range of international brands, dining options, and entertainment facilities. Residents can easily enjoy shopping without traveling far from the International City.

Schools and Nurseries in International City

Families living in International City have access to various schools and nurseries that cater to different age groups. Popular educational institutions include GEMS Modern Academy and International School of Arts and Sciences, both of which offer international curriculums. 

For younger children, nurseries like Kids World International Nursery and The Children's House Nursery provide quality early education and childcare. Schools in International City Dubai ensure families with children can find excellent educational options without long commutes. This makes the area appealing for families looking for affordable housing and good schooling.

Churches, Temples, and Mosques in and near International City Location

International City is home to several mosques, such as the International City Mosque and Al Manama Mosque, which serve the Muslim community.

St. Mary’s Catholic Church is a 25-minute drive away, while Hindu temples in Bur Dubai, such as the Shiva Temple, are approximately 30 minutes away by car. The diversity of places of worship in and near International City ensures that residents from various religious backgrounds have easy access to their respective worship centers, fostering a sense of community and inclusion.

Clinics and Hospitals in and near International City Area

International City residents can access various healthcare facilities, including Aster Clinic and Life Line Medical Centre. These clinics offer general medical services, specialist consultations, and diagnostic services. For more comprehensive healthcare, residents can visit Fakeeh University Hospital near Dubai Silicon Oasis Clinic, within a short drive.

International City Dubai Location & Nearby Areas

International City Dubai location is ideal for those seeking affordable yet well-connected living. In addition to the original International City, International City 2 is an extension offering new and improved residential and commercial facilities.

Adjacent to International City is the Warsan community, which includes Warsan Village and Warsan Souk. Warsan Village offers a family-friendly living environment with modern townhouses, while Warsan Souk provides an extensive range of retail and dining options. 

The area is conveniently located near Dubai Silicon Oasis and Academic City, providing easy access to critical business and educational hubs. Dubai International Airport is approximately a 15-minute drive, making it convenient for frequent travelers.

more_info.question: Things to Do in Villanova Area

data.answer:
International City offers various activities for residents and visitors. There's something for everyone, from exploring the vast Dragon Mart for shopping to enjoying nature at the nearby Ras Al Khor Wildlife Sanctuary. The area also has parks, jogging tracks, and local cultural events, ensuring a lively and engaging environment year-round.

International City Dubai Restaurants

International City is a true foodie hub, offering various authentic cuisines that cater to its multicultural population. The area is known for its hidden gem eateries, where you can enjoy Chinese, Indian, Pakistani, Middle Eastern, and Mediterranean dishes. 

Popular local spots include Al Reef Lebanese Bakery, Little China Restaurant, and Pak Darbar, serving affordable and flavorful meals. Unlike other parts of Dubai, International City doesn't feature licensed restaurants or bars, so those looking for a pint must venture towards the city center. However, for quick bites, the area also has popular fast-food chains like KFC and Pizza Hut.

Beaches Near International City

Residents can easily access Dubai’s stunning beaches within a short drive. Jumeirah Beach, known for its pristine waters and scenic views of the Burj Al Arab, is a 30-minute drive from International City. 

Another famous beach, Kite Beach, is about 35 minutes away and offers a variety of water sports, food trucks, and activities for beachgoers. While International City does not have direct access to beaches, the proximity to these popular coastal areas makes it easy for residents to enjoy Dubai’s vibrant beach scene on weekends or holidays.

Hotels in the International City Area

Several hotels in International City and nearby areas cater to budget and midrange travelers. The Ibis Styles Dragon Mart hotel is located near Dragon Mart, offering affordable rooms with modern amenities. Premier Inn Silicon Oasis is another popular choice. It is just a short drive away and provides comfortable accommodations and business facilities. 

For those seeking a more luxurious stay, Palazzo Versace is a 20-minute drive from International City and offers opulent rooms and world-class dining. Visitors to International City have various accommodation options, making it easy to find the right place to stay.

Outdoor Activities, Fitness, and Beauty

International City offers a variety of options for outdoor activities, fitness, and beauty services, ensuring a well-rounded lifestyle for its residents. One of the latest additions to the area is the Lake District in Al Warsan, featuring Al Warsan Lake, which is surrounded by landscaped parks, perfect for evening walks and jogs. Families can also enjoy Paris Children’s Park in the France cluster, providing a safe play area for kids.

Several well-equipped gyms in International City are available for fitness enthusiasts. Popular options include V Fitness, Fitness 360, Target Gym, and Snap Fitness, offering state-of-the-art equipment and group classes. In addition to these, many residential buildings also have small fitness centers. Nature lovers can visit the nearby Ras Al Khor Wildlife Sanctuary for relaxing nature walks and bird watching.

Beauty salons like NStyle Beauty Lounge offer a wide range of grooming and pampering services, from hair care to spa treatments. With its combination of outdoor activities, fitness centers, and beauty services, International City ensures residents lead a balanced and healthy lifestyle.

International City Attractions and Landmarks

One of the most notable landmarks in International City is Dragon Mart, a vast retail complex offering various goods at affordable prices.

Ras Al Khor Wildlife Sanctuary is a short drive from International City, allowing residents to observe native wildlife, including flamingos. These landmarks and attractions make International City a diverse and exciting area to explore, offering shopping and cultural experiences.

Located just a short drive from International City, Dubai Safari Park is home to a wide range of animal species and offers immersive wildlife experiences, perfect for family outings and nature lovers.

International City offers affordable housing and a lively community, making it an attractive choice for many. While the area experiences some traffic during peak hours, particularly around Dragon Mart, residents benefit from well-connected road networks.
Here is the International City Dubai map, which provides a detailed view of the area, its clusters, and nearby amenities.

How much is a studio rental in International City? 

A studio for rent in International City typically starts at around AED 29,000 annually, offering budget-friendly accommodation options.

Are there good schools in International City Dubai? 

 Yes, schools in International City Dubai include GEMS Modern Academy and the International School of Arts and Sciences, providing quality education for children.

How far is the International City from Dubai International Airport?  

Dubai International Airport is approximately a 25-minute drive from International City, making it convenient for frequent travelers.

Is parking available in International City?  

Free street parking is available in International City, but not all buildings have dedicated parking spaces for visitors. Residents and visitors may need to find a spot on the street.

data.content:
International City in Dubai is a distinctively themed residential and business district, known for its affordable housing options and diverse community. Spanning 800 hectares, the development is designed to reflect the architectural styles of various countries, creating a vibrant, global atmosphere for residents.

The area is divided into country-themed clusters, each featuring residences and commercial centers inspired by nations such as China, England, Italy, and Russia. These districts are complemented by landscaped gardens and open spaces, fostering a strong sense of community and outdoor living.

International City appeals to both singles and families due to its affordability and availability of a wide range of amenities, including retail stores, restaurants, medical facilities, and schools. Its excellent connectivity via major highways and public transport makes it a convenient and cost-effective option for those looking for a multicultural lifestyle in Dubai.

nodes.title: Coventry II
nodes.about:
Developed by GFS Developments, Coventry 2 at Warsan 4 in Dubai is a high-rise residential project designed to balance connectivity, comfort, and long-term investment value. The development comprises studios and one-bedroom apartments. Select one-bedroom units come with a study, supported by efficient layouts and practical unit sizes suitable for both end users and investors.

Located within a growing residential district, Coventry 2 at International City Phase 3 enjoys close proximity to major destinations including Downtown Dubai, Dragon Mart, Global Village, and Mirdif City Centre. With access to the upcoming Blue Line Metro Station and a structured long-term payment plan, Coventry II apartments in Dubai are positioned to benefit from sustained demand and infrastructure-led appreciation.

nodes.title: RISE
nodes.about:
RISE by Blanco Thornton is a mid-rise residential development located in the heart of International City. Developed by Blanco Thornton Properties, the project features ten floors of thoughtfully designed 1 and 2-bedroom apartments that blend modern aesthetics with practical layouts. Each residence is crafted to offer a harmonious balance of style and functionality, catering to the needs of contemporary urban living.

Strategically positioned for seamless connectivity, RISE provides residents with easy access to major thoroughfares such as Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road (E311) and Al Khail Road (E44), facilitating convenient travel across Dubai. The development boasts a selection of premium amenities, including a state-of-the-art fitness center, yoga and meditation studio, and landscaped gardens, enhancing the quality of life for its residents.

nodes.title: Kensington Gardens
nodes.about:
Kensington Gardens by LEOS Developers is an extraordinary residential community that introduces Dubai’s first crystal healing homes, designed to enhance wellbeing and elevate daily living. Nestled within the serene Greenwood neighborhood, the development offers luxurious 3 to 7-bedroom townhouses and standalone villas. Using British technology, each home integrates crystal healing elements, creating a balanced and harmonious environment. With spacious layouts, premium finishes, and nature-inspired surroundings, Kensington Gardens offers residents a tranquil retreat from the fast-paced city life. 

Located within Dubai’s newest and greenest district, Greenwood, this development combines luxury living with sustainability. Residents can enjoy access to lush green spaces, a central park, and an array of community amenities designed for an active and healthy lifestyle.

nodes.title: Olivz
nodes.about:
Olivz is a luxury project by developer Danube Properties. The 7-storey residential complex is located in the mixed-use neighborhood of Al Warsan First in one of the most sought-after locations in Dubai. Olivz offers elegant and modern residences, where the complex is surrounded by landscaped gardens and water bodies. For sale are studios and apartments with 1 and 2 bedrooms. The interiors are designed in a modern style using neutral tones, which creates a cozy atmosphere. Also made with high quality finishing materials and fully equipped with modern furniture and appliances.

World-class amenities are provided for residents: gym, tennis court, swimming pool, children's pool, recreation areas, children's playground, SPA area, sports fields, as well as within walking distance to cafes, restaurants and retail outlets. Every aspect is precisely organized to provide the perfect living space.

The Al Warsan First neighborhood is well positioned to provide Olivz residents with quick access to key points in Dubai. Dubai Safari, Dubai Silicon Oasis, Meydan Racecourse and Dubai Safari are just 10 minutes away. Dubai Mall and Burj Khalifa are approximately 20 minutes away. Palm Jumeirah is 30 minutes away. Dubai International Airport is 13 minutes away.
